title: When Morning Gilds the Skies
lyrics_original: To God, the Word, on high,
Their voice in shouts of praise,
With this I shield my breast,
When this sweet chant they hear:
Sing, suns and stars of space,
Sing, ye that see His face,

bible_verses.english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name; that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, as I awaken to this new day, I offer my heart to You in praise. Be present in every moment—in my work, my prayers, my joy, and my sadness. When earthly comforts seem to fade, remind me that Your grace is my constant comfort and refuge. May my life continually declare Your goodness, today and always. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: As dawn breaks and a new day begins, this hymn invites us to anchor our hearts in praise to Jesus before the busyness takes over. Whether we are embarking on daily tasks, lingering in quiet prayer, or carrying quiet burdens of sorrow, making "Let Jesus Christ be praised" our refrain reframes every circumstance. When earthly comforts fade, His unshakeable love remains our ultimate solace. May your heart find joy today in turning every moment—bright or dim—into a song of worship.
